evidence.note: Court record reproduces the Feb 27 Hegseth directive ordering designation and calling the decision final. It describes a permanent government-wide bar with a six-month transition. Filed before the evaluation date.

reviews.rationale: Government directives reproduced in the court record show an announced permanent, government-wide exclusion and a public order to designate Anthropic a supply-chain risk, going beyond rejecting its terms. The court found the actions retaliatory. The later formal designation and the April restoration do not undercut the claim about Feb 27–28.
